record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare ORIGIN_PULSE: Kyogre (3 stars, passive PRIMAL) and Primal Kyogre (4 stars, passive RAIN_OR_STORM). Shared strategy; only the star count and stats differ. The two passives were not traced for any interaction with this ability.
record.summary: SPECIAL damage to every enemy unit standing in the same board row as the cast target (any distance, including the target itself): 100 raw at 3 stars (Kyogre), 120 raw at 4 stars (Primal Kyogre). The row is the target's positionY at the moment of the cast; each hit is resolved independently with the same crit flag. No status, heal or shield.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target) defines the row; all enemies of the caster's team in that row are hit
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read.

geometry.shape: full board row of the target (y equal), enemies only; no distance limit

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) per target (apBoost defaults to true); a cast crit multiplies by critPower reduced by each target's critReductionFactor (needs ABILITY_CRIT: canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: requested amount per target = raw x AP x crit factor; applied: handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x speDef) with speDef halved if the target has armor reduction active, ceil, minimum 1, shield first; takenDamage is not used by this ability. A target with protect / skydiving / magicBounce takes 0 (magicBounce may reflect SPECIAL damage unless the caster holds Protective Pads); a dead or resurrecting target takes 0.

starBehavior.note: indexed by the caster's stars; the table has five entries (50, 75, 100, 120, 150): 1, 2 and 5 star values are not reachable by the two listed units. maxPP 100 and range 3 for both.

record.positionalConditions: Row of the cast target; enemies only (team different from the caster). Range 3 for both casters.
record.rawVsResolved: Declared raw: 100 (Kyogre, 3 stars) / 120 (Primal Kyogre, 4 stars) per enemy in the row. Damage dealt = raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor], then speDef division (ceil, at least 1). The raw values are not the damage a target loses.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Shield, Cover Band, Fossil and resurrection branches of handleDamage were not traced here (takenDamage is unused by ORIGIN_PULSE); consulted core-mechanics.md section A and the speDef step only
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence): only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the ABILITY_CRIT / canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
unresolved: The PRIMAL and RAIN_OR_STORM passives were not traced; a search for Passive.PRIMAL and Passive.RAIN_OR_STORM in app/core and app/models/colyseus-models found only the class declarations, so no effect wired to them there was found, but other lookup paths (weather, effect maps keyed otherwise) were not searched
Whether units killed earlier in the same forEach pass are still visited cannot matter here (each target is independent) and was not examined
No other unit sharing the identifier exists in the queue; units not listed are not covered
Mechanical checks only; no probe was run and no fight observed
